title: Selected PR1094: one neutral move opens a strict two-step packing gain
body:
## Scope

One explicit two-move, three-bin positive witness on the selected PR1094 owner map. The chooser seed is `893dae841093010f4e6385353a3c2714` (`incumbent-optimization`, `selected-packing`, priority revision 3); exact base main is `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, and selected-record SHA-256 is `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`. Coordination claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18921993.

This is complementary to open PR #1790: that package censuses simultaneous two-role swaps and explicitly leaves sequential neutral-then-improving paths open. This PR gives one exact legal witness. It does not enumerate the open path class or replay #1790.

## Construction

1. Move width-7 helper `(stage=7, replica=2, helper=230)` from `(1,14,57)` to `(13,15,14)`. Free remainders change `(0,7) -> (7,0)`, preserving the full idle histogram. Event position 268 lies strictly inside the destination window `(255,430)`.
2. Move width-7 helper `(stage=1, replica=15, helper=226)` from `(11,8,103)` to `(1,14,57)`. Its event position 181 lies inside `(92,272)`. This landing is window/family legal initially but cannot fit the initially full bin; after step 1 its remainder is 7. The remainders change `(1,7) -> (8,0)`.

Strict concavity of `t^(1-a)` for every real `0<a<1` proves the first move is neutral and the second strictly improves the idle moment uniformly on that interval. The final idle profile is `{1:2275, 3:377, 7:6, 8:1, 48:4866}`. The complete 69,120-role owner audit accepts the map, including source-event windows, family uniqueness, occupied prefixes, rank mass and halving guard.

## Pricing and scope

The exact outward-rounded complex-moment root rises from the certified bracket around `0.001675462676808` to the bracket around `0.001675464332527`; certified gain is at least `291277/175921860444160` (about `1.66e-9`). The unchanged bit endpoint is `1733427039589844234749/1000000000000000000000000`, still above the new complex endpoint, so complex remains the binding primitive in the retained supplier comparison. The fixed-word packing cap remains `a < 0.001690054109089`; the constructed endpoint is about 99.14% of that cap and closes about 0.0114% of the remaining gap.

This is a conditional fixed-word packing improvement, not a source-bound supplier rebuild, invoice, new supplier endpoint or new `kappa`. The selected record is unchanged. Exact before/after brackets, source pins, the owner audit and limitations are in `research/selected-neutral-path-seed893/`.

## Verification

Passed locally under CPython 3.14.7:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/selected-neutral-path-seed893/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/selected-neutral-path-seed893/test_verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-neutral-path-seed893 --check-only
python3 -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
```

The tests include the legal positive path, the direct-move capacity failure before the neutral step, an invalid-window control, a family mutation rejected by the full owner checker, exact uniform moment signs and certified endpoint increase. The registered package runner requires Python 3.12, which is unavailable locally; its package metadata/pins check passed and direct replay/tests pass on 3.14.7.
